newsitem.title: UK: OPTIONS -UK supermarkets busy from mixed trades.
newsitem.headline: OPTIONS -UK supermarkets busy from mixed trades.

text.p: Traded options of supermarket chains Safeway and Tesco were busy from mixed trades on Tuesday, dealers said.
The biggest deal in Safeway was from a trader who bought 849 April 390 calls at 6p and sold 850 July 360 calls at 24p and dealers believed this may have been to roll forward a short call position.
By 1345 GMT, Safeway shares had added a penny to 361-1/2p.
In Tesco there was a seller of 250 February 330 calls at 13-1/2p -- ahead of tomorrow's expiry -- and in a separate deal, another trader bought 250 lots in the same series.
British Steel options were also lively owing to mixed trading. One trader sold 2,000 April 140 calls at 7p and in a separate trade a buyer came forth to purchase 2,000 lots at the same price.
Many other stock options trades concerned the expiry of the February options series tomorrow.
Over in FTSE 100 index options volatility trades were popular with traders who took an options position which was hedged by an opposite position in FTSE futures.
One such deal was the sale of a put spread against selling futures. It involved buying 500 March 4125 puts at 28-1/2p and selling 500 March 4225 puts at 14p against selling March futures at 4337.
Other traders who took the view that market volatility would increase, struck opposite deals trading in lot sizes of 500 in the same FTSE options.
By 1345 GMT, spot FTSE was up 1.5 at 4339.3 while March futures were up three points at 4328.
-- Pradip Mishra, London Newsroom +44 171 542 7954 *FOR FUTURES AND OPTIONS EXPIRY DATES PLEASE SEE PAGE UKA4 *
